Only the first 4 doses of the routine 5-dose DTaP series are encoded (expected by age 2, derived; rule goes to human review). The numerator window runs to {MY}-12-31, so it can credit doses given after the 2nd birthday; it does not restrict to doses given before the birthday.

Dose 5 at age 4-6 years is not encoded as a rule. 'Dose 5 is not necessary if dose 4 was administered at age 4 years or older and at least 6 months after dose 3' depends on dose dates relative to birth and to prior doses. This cannot be expressed in the grammar, and omitting it would falsely flag compliant children.
Minimum age 6 weeks (4 years for Kinrix or Quadracel) for valid doses is not enforced. Product choice (Kinrix/Quadracel) is not represented.
Minimum intervals are not represented: prospective dose 4 as early as 12 months if at least 6 months since dose 3; retrospective counting of an early dose 4 if at least 4 months since dose 3.

Special situation not represented: Td may replace DTaP for remaining doses in children younger than 7 years with a pertussis-specific contraindication (encephalopathy within 7 days of vaccination not attributable to another cause). Td doses are not credited and these children are not excluded.

Wound management is not represented: DTaP for non-clean/non-minor wounds if more than 5 years since the last tetanus-toxoid dose, in children younger than 7 years with 3 or more prior doses. This depends on injury events and clinician judgment.
No exclusions (e.g., deceased, contraindication) are stated in the section, so none are encoded.
